notes.title: Update march 2021
notes.content:
Update Content :
-	New languages : Russian, japanese, Chinese
-	Added Save slots
-	Added PC shortcuts
-	Possibility to lock the planet in place.
-	4 technologies at each level 
-	Destroying slots with weapons let go a part of its resources into space as asteroids.
-	Enemy faction can let go only one planet and part of their structures stay on the planet (higher chance when the enemy got a lot of planets)
-	Pinatosaurus got higher rewards
-	A planet without civilians is lost to your faction
-	Civilians without house won’t grant ascension at each cycle.
-	Improved AI: Enemy faction will be improved base on your trades and will get hurt more severely in their economy while losing planets. Each IA has a game plan at the beginning of the game. IA playstyle is influenced by their species.
-	Feedback on AI state while trading
-	Quest : IA will time to time offer you a special trade with a fixed time to complete.
-	2 new modes:
o	Scaling ascension: ascension depends on your faction level
o	2 species game: start the game with two different species
-	2 new technologies : 
o	SPACE_EXPLORATION : the cost is the same for 2 civilians, 20% reduction on travel cost
o	MARTIALE_CULTURE : get ascension from killing enemy faction civilians and destroying planets slots.
-	Various Game Tweaks : 
o	Food Recipes are more generous
o	Higher level Food structures are more efficient
o	Ascension recipes are more generous
o	Essential technologies arrive earlier more often
o	Unlock rocket more quickly
o	Iron and copper can be found more often in various biomes
o	Terraformation cost is lowered
o	Wonders give a bonus of +1 in production to every structure either in science or ascension
o	Passing a level allow to discover more space / astronomy increase in sight is less strong
o	Fast building technology is even more fast
o	Base travel cost now 20 (from 10)
o	Enemy factions surrenders more easily if they have fewer planets
o	All your civilians won’t die in one go from Hunger
